## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 10-fascicle commentary on *Dà bān niè pán jīng* 大般涅槃經 ([KR6g0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0001)) is by [淨影慧遠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E5%BD%B1%E6%85%A7%E9%81%A0) Jìngyǐng Huìyuǎn (523–592). One of the most substantial Suí-period commentaries on the *Niè-pán jīng* and a foundational document of mature Chinese Buddha-nature doctrine.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (580–592) reflects Jìngyǐng Huìyuǎn's mature Suí period.
